description: This file contains test setup and a test suite for verifying the behavior of the TypeScript Node.js project, specifically Issue #1778 related to module type resolution based on package.json 'exports'. It imports helper functions, configuration constants, and uses a testing framework to define and run a test case.

methods.name: test.suite
methods.description: Defines a test suite with a descriptive name and a callback to contain individual tests.

methods.name: test.if
methods.description: Conditionally executes tests based on environment capabilities.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case with a description and async test function.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a command in a specified working directory and returns a result object.
